'''Byrdonis''' is an {{2|Elites|Elite}} found in the {{2|Overgrowth}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Byrdonis}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Swoop
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (17;{{Asc2|9|19}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Peck
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (3x3;{{Asc2|9|4x3}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Byrdonis alternates between its two moves in a fixed pattern:
# {{Int2|Byrdonis|Swoop}}.
# {{Int2|Byrdonis|Peck}}.
# Back to {{Int2|Byrdonis|Swoop}}, and so on.

== Notes ==
* {{Int2|Byrdonis|Peck}} hits 3 times, so each point of {{BD2|Strength}} adds 3 extra damage total on Peck turns.

== Trivia ==
* Both of '''Byrdonis's''' attacks are represented in Attack cards ({{C2|Byrd Swoop}} deals high damage in one hit, and {{C2|Peck}} hits three times for lower damage).
* '''Byrdonis''' strongly resembles a terror bird (''Phorusrhacos'') in appearance and behaviour.
